headline: Anthropic made Claude Duet available by waitlist to US subscribers
body: Anthropic says Claude Duet keeps working while the user is away, and it only reaches out when something needs attention. It waits for approval before sending a message, making a payment, signing a document or deleting anything. Bank transfers are blocked entirely, and purchases run through Stripe Link with a virtual card.
note: For banks and payment firms, the early limits matter: Anthropic concedes that the early version can misread a message thread, misjudge urgency and miss things that arrive between two checks.

evidence.text: The standalone app runs Claude as a proactive agent that keeps working on tasks while the user is away and asks for approval before taking sensitive steps.
After that, it only reaches out when something needs attention.
Anthropic made Claude Duet available by waitlist to Pro and Max subscribers in the U.S. on Wednesday.
